controls.name: init-no-tstart
controls.description: the command does not open its transaction (TSTART at Utils/Module.cls#L1195 removed)

controls.name: guard-ignores-force
controls.description: install refuses a newer version with an update package even with -force

controls.name: downgrade-allowed
controls.description: the downgrade check is removed (the guard lets an older target through; the older version is written at the manifest step)

controls.name: manifest-commits-always
controls.description: the manifest is committed in every mode, not only developer mode

controls.name: force-install-not-seeded
controls.description: Activate does not seed the steps of a forced install

controls.name: no-rollback-on-failure
controls.description: a failed command keeps the writes of its open transaction

controls.name: crash-keeps-open-writes
controls.description: a halt commits the open transaction (premise P2 broken)

controls.name: seed-step-not-saved
controls.description: the seeding walk does not save the seeded record

controls.name: seeding-skips-failed-steps
controls.description: seeding leaves a step that failed last time as it is

controls.name: flag-not-reset-per-class
controls.description: newStepToApply carries over from one class to the next

controls.name: run-test-ignores-status
controls.description: the run test checks only TimeStampEnd, not the status of the last run

controls.name: mirror-skip-ignored
controls.description: primary-only steps run on a non-primary mirror member

controls.name: no-premise-pl
controls.description: drop premise PL (the update lock is granted)

controls.name: no-premise-pf5
controls.description: drop premise PF5 (the run has the developer mode asked for, or the stored one); the bridge lemma inst_lemma_pf5 that every step lemma uses for the run's mode must fail

controls.name: l1-update-ok-unconstrained
controls.description: vacuity: L1 without 'an OK update ran every due step' must lose the busy-lock witness (F-INST-1)

controls.name: l1-dev-failure-unconstrained
controls.description: vacuity: L1 without 'a developer-mode failure is kept' must lose the F-INST-5 witness

controls.name: l1-missing-record-not-due-a
controls.description: vacuity: L1 where a step with no record is not due must lose the DEC-INST-2 witness

controls.name: l1-missing-record-not-due-b
controls.description: vacuity: the same L1 change must lose the DEC-INST-5 witness (the retry reruns the step)

controls.name: l1-step-classes-unconstrained
controls.description: vacuity: L1 without 'every step class is walked' must lose the F-INST-6 witness

controls.name: l1-class-list-error-accepted
controls.description: vacuity: L1 that accepts a failing class list must lose the F-INST-7 witness

controls.name: dev-success-reported-failed
controls.description: finding 1, reviewer mutant 5: a developer-mode install or load whose phases worked ends Out::Failed

controls.name: phase-failure-reported-ok
controls.description: finding 1, converse: a phase that threw ends Out::Ok (passes the old one-way L1 in developer mode)

controls.name: step-failure-reported-ok
controls.description: finding 1, converse: an update step that threw ends Out::Ok

controls.name: walk-end-reported-failed
controls.description: finding 1: a walk that ran every step ends Out::Failed and rolls back (passes the old one-way L1 with a transaction)

controls.name: crash-reports-success
controls.description: finding 1: a halted command reports success

controls.name: stored-dev-ignored
controls.description: finding 7: with no -dev/-nodev typed, the run ignores the stored DeveloperMode (Utils/Module.cls#L1305); the run's mode then differs from L1 want_dev, which inst_lemma_pf5 (used by every step lemma) states

controls.name: guard-reads-stored-dev
controls.description: finding 7: the install/load guard reads the run's developer mode (stored mode included) instead of the DeveloperMode parameter (#L1219)

controls.name: seeding-tests-typed-flag
controls.description: finding 7: Activate seeds by the typed -dev flag instead of the module's stored DeveloperMode (Lifecycle/Module.cls#L122)
